runsWhen: Before the agent calls a tool.

inputs.name: toolName
inputs.description: Name of the tool the agent is about to call.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: The arguments the agent wants to pass to the tool. Its internal shape per tool is not documented; inspect one run before you write conditions against it.

outputs.name: permissionDecision
outputs.description: Set to deny to block the tool call. Leave empty to allow it.

outputs.name: permissionDecisionReason
outputs.description: Why the call was blocked. Only used when denying.

outputs.name: modifiedParameters
outputs.description: Replacement arguments for the tool call. Leave empty to keep the original.

outputs.name: additionalContext
outputs.description: Extra text passed to the model alongside the tool call.

outputs.name: suppressOutput
outputs.description: Set to true to hide this tool's output from the user.
